# llms.txt - Information for AI/LLM crawlers
# https://jobhelper-c3cd7.web.app

# About
JobTracker is a personal job application tracking tool that helps job seekers
organize and manage their job search process.

# Features
- Kanban board for tracking job applications across stages (Wishlist, Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected)
- Chrome extension for one-click job saving from LinkedIn, Indeed, and other job boards
- AI-powered job extraction using Google Gemini API
- Google Sign-In authentication
- Cloud sync across devices
- Mobile-optimized experience
- GDPR-compliant data management (export, delete account)

# Pages
/           - Dashboard with job statistics and quick actions
/kanban     - Kanban board view for managing job applications
/profile    - User profile and preferences
/install    - Chrome extension installation instructions
/privacy    - Privacy Policy (GDPR compliant)
/terms      - Terms of Service

# Technology Stack
- Next.js 16 (React 19)
- Firebase Authentication & Firestore
- Zustand for state management
- Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
- Google Gemini API for AI features
